title: Infused Crystal Casing
text: Hold one Infused Spiritual Crystal and right-click a Spiritual Crystal Block to turn it into an Infused Crystal Casing, consuming the crystal on success. Its clear body and connecting trim match the Crystal Casing, but its rim glows pale white.

Both casings can wrap Create shafts, both cogwheel sizes and fluid pipes. A wrench removes a standalone casing; wrenching an encased shaft toggles its axial connection, and sneak-wrenching removes its shell. Encased pipes retain their connections and pump-driven flow; ordinary wrenching removes the pipe shell.
